content: The dual-write problem: writing to a service's own DB and publishing an event are not atomic across two systems, so a crash between them causes inconsistency. The transactional outbox pattern writes the event to an outbox table in the same DB transaction as the business change, then a relay (poller or CDC like Debezium) publishes it asynchronously, guaranteeing at-least-once delivery; consumers must be idempotent.
